svg.title: How stale can a client be?
svg.desc: Share of handshakes that can use a landmark-relative certificate, against hours since the client last updated its landmarks. Seven-day certificates renewed at 75 percent, both kept until expiry, one hour from landmark to client. The share is 100 percent up to about 40 hours, then falls linearly: 94 percent at 48 hours, 75 at 72, 56 at 96, 38 at 120, 18 at 144, 0 at 168. The expected authentication bytes rise from 4,296 to 11,417 along the same line.

text.tspan: hours since the client last received landmarks
